beta.notes:
New in this version:
• To-do brings work from every learning period into one list, with clearer separation between your next actions and work awaiting a student.
• Reading & AI offers None, OCR only, and OCR + AI, with a separate choice for automatic pregrading. Core sample defaults and individual student schedules are easier to adjust.
• Grade groups Chat, Rubric and File tools into tabs. Comparison previews now include page thumbnails, and dragging the thumbnail viewport pans the page.
• Finalize remembers your Email family choice. PDF output and appearance settings are more compact, with clearer PCA sample guidance.
• Fresh coastal update artwork and new Buddy app icons.

Fixes:
• Page thumbnails stay centered and stable when selecting, reordering and resizing. Finalized packets remain protected until you unfinalize them.
• Changing Reading & AI settings safely holds background work and preserves teacher edits and paused queues.
• Receipt recovery handles more locally captured PDF and HTML files, offers manual filing when needed, and provides more useful diagnostics.
• Filtered To-do and email actions retain the correct assignment and student. Finishing Verify returns to To-do, and Finalize shows clearer progress.
